The grammar parses the union and ArithmeticBinder narrows it to the formats; VisitRoundedPhrase refuses ROUNDED MODE below 2014 (COBOL0803); VisitConditionalPhrases through ConditionalPhrases.OutOfPrintedOrder refuses the NOT phrase first (COBOL0900, kb/Work PB5158 landed); ExpressionBinder.BindArithmeticStatementOperand and IntrinsicBinder.ScreenIdentifierPlacement refuse a function-identifier as an identifier operand at 85 (COBOL0900, kb/Work PB5108 landed, the defect this row last named).
